title: Run prompt
text: Trim and lock before asynchronous work.
explanation: The shared main-actor ObservableObject retains prompt, mode, answer and timeline across all five native tabs.

title: Start native HTTP request
text: Build JSON for the configured server origin.
explanation: Only a non-secret API origin is stored on the device. URLSession owns the HTTPS request; no model key is bundled.

title: Receive prompt in Node
explanation: The transport owns an abort controller tied to connection close and flushes the handler response with backpressure. No shared secret is embedded in the app.

title: Validate Node input
text: Bound actual JSON bytes and validate a trimmed string.
explanation: The Node API checks media type, 32 KiB actual bytes and 1–4000 UTF-16 units before SDK execution. Browser origins use an explicit allowlist; native requests have no Origin.

title: Start real SDK runtime
text: Execute the actual TypeScript Agent SDK.
explanation: Node owns the private Anthropic key, CLI subprocess and per-request temporary work/home/config directories with tools, settings, skills, MCP, plugins and persistence disabled.

title: Exchange with Claude
explanation: The SDK runtime owns provider HTTPS. This is an application boundary excerpt rather than invented raw provider transport.

title: Project safe SDK message
text: Select public lifecycle and text fields.
explanation: Private thinking, paths, session identifiers and tool payloads are omitted. API key occurrences are redacted.

title: Flush Node SSE
text: Flush headers and await the response pipeline.
explanation: The Node pipeline handles backpressure. Closing the native connection cancels the owned SDK controller; execution also has a 180-second deadline.

title: Decode SSE frames
text: Accumulate bytes until complete UTF-8 lines and events.
explanation: CRLF, comments, multiline data and fragmented Unicode are handled without decoding partial characters. Frames are capped at 1 MiB.

title: Normalize final result
text: Preserve reported metrics and error semantics.
explanation: Non-success SDK result subtypes remain errors and missing cost remains null.

title: Require result and done
explanation: A typed final result and done are both required. A safe error event fails the run even if an answer was already received.

title: Render colored native output
text: Render native Markdown and attributed code.
explanation: Fenced snippets use the syntax-coloring CodeBlock. Native Text does not execute HTML; external links are restricted to HTTP/HTTPS.

title: Complete stream
text: Send done only after a final result.
explanation: Done completes the transport and never changes a failed SDK result into a success.

title: Send safe error
text: Emit a safe failure without done.
explanation: Provider diagnostics remain server-side. The client shows feedback and the user may retry.

title: Release UI after failure
explanation: Cancellation closes the owned URLSession, releases execution controls after cleanup and preserves prompt and output.

title: Reject missing key
text: Stop before creating an SDK run.
explanation: Only backend/.env stores ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Missing keys produce query503 or an SSE error without done; health checks presence, not account access.
